condition_index.description: Zero-based position of the release condition in `filters.groups`, counted from the read that produced `version`.

id.description: A unique integer value identifying this feature flag.

rollout_percentage.description: Percentage of the users matching that condition who are served the flag, 0 through 100. On a multivariate flag this is how many matching users get a variant at all, not how the variants are split between them. Fractional percentages such as 0.5 are accepted, the same as a write that sends `filters`.

version.description: The `version` from your most recent read of this flag. The change is refused with 409 if anyone else changed the flag after that version.
